data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter calendar widget supporting month and week views and streak highlights.
data.what_it_does: Provides a calendar widget that can be embedded into Flutter apps to display monthly or weekly views. It allows date selection, streak tracking, and extensive customization of styles, headers, and date properties.
use_when: You need to display a customizable month or week calendar inside a Flutter app.
You want to highlight streak dates or custom selections visually.
avoid_when: You need a robust built-in single date selection mode (single selection mode was removed in 1.0.0 due to bugs).
You require a heavy-duty event scheduler or agenda view.
strengths: Supports both month and week calendar views.
Highly customizable dates, headers, weekdays, and streak displays.
Cross-platform support (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux).
weaknesses: Early stage of development with potential breaking changes.
Single selection mode is deprecated/removed, requiring workarounds via singleOrMultiple.
